run_ocr_text_cli: run the ocr_text_cli function to extract text from images using Surya OCR with configurable task name and math recognition
run_ocr_with_boxes: run ocr_text_cli with task_name ocr_with_boxes to perform OCR text extraction with bounding box annotations on input images
run_ocr_disable_math: run ocr_text_cli with disable_math flag to perform OCR text recognition without math formula detection
run_ocr_save_images: run ocr_text_cli to perform OCR and save annotated images with predicted text drawn on bounding boxes
run_ocr_output_json: run ocr_text_cli to perform OCR and output structured results.json with page numbers and text line predictions per image
